prompt: Which of these is a famous place to visit in São Tomé and Príncipe?

options.text: Ilhéu das Rolas, on the Equator

explanation: Ilhéu das Rolas, on the Equator is one of the two places we'd love to visit in São Tomé and Príncipe. This tiny island sits exactly on the Equator line — you can stand with one foot in each hemisphere, then swim at its quiet beaches.
